OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already belongs to the same household (i.e. shares the same last name and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. When false or omitted, such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            validated only when present, stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already belongs to the same household (i.e. shares the same last name and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. When false or omitted, such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            validated only when present, stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by
                spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN
                is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than
                the number of owners at the time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M20'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the household, the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the owner's normalized last name and
                postcode. Owners with the same last name (compared case-insensitively
                with surrounding whitespace trimmed) and postcode are automatically
                assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b9c4d5e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived duplicate-detection key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the email segment is
                empty when the owner has no email. Two owners are considered
                duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3f2a1b9c4d5e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, computed on creation: starting at 0,
                adding 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 when the
                owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure
                exceeds 365 days since the registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration day at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to the

                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's lastName and postcode but had a different

              type: integer
              format: int32

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied they take
            precedence. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended
            when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat address; it is normalized on create
            (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations
            expanded) and the composed address is derived from it.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed address after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already belongs to the same household (i.e. shares the same last name and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. When false or omitted, such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            validated only when present, stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by
                spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

## Summary

Added a structured address form to the owner-create flow while keeping the flat `address` input backward-compatible.

**API contract** (`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`)
- Added optional `addressLine1` and `addressLine2` to the `OwnerFields` schema (which flows into both the request DTO and the response `Owner` DTO via the generator).
- Removed `address` from the `required` list so structured-only payloads pass bean validation; documented `address` as the composed, normalized read value.

**Domain model** (`Owner.java`)
- Added `addressLine1` / `addressLine2` fields (`address_line1`, `address_line2` columns) with getters/setters. MapStruct maps them by name in both directions with no mapper changes.

**Database schema** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres `schema.sql`)
- Added nullable `address_line1` / `address_line2` columns to the `owners` table.

**Controller** (`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`)
- Replaced the single flat-address normalization with a new `applyAddress` helper that:
  - Normalizes whichever address fields are supplied (reusing the existing `normalizeAddress` rules — trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand `ST→STREET` etc.).
  - Prefers the structured form: when `addressLine1` is non-blank, the composed `address` is the normalized `addressLine1`, with a single space + normalized `addressLine2` appended when line 2 is present; otherwise it falls back to the normalized flat `address`.
  - Writes the normalized structured fields and the composed `address` back onto the DTO, so everything downstream (household hash, postcode validation, locality, storage, response) reads the resolved address. When neither form is supplied the composed value is blank, so the existing required-field check rejects it.

Both acceptance tests (`coreNormalizesAndComposesStructuredAddress`, `functionalityStillAcceptsFlatAddress`) pass, and the full suite is green (`Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`).
